proposal.hypothesis: The search is stuck in a local optimum with high material residual correlation, indicating that the current model is not capturing essential structure. Reducing parsimony pressure may allow the search to explore more complex expressions and escape this stagnation.
proposal.falsification: If reducing parsimony does not lead to a decrease in material residual correlation or an improvement in scientific score within a few rounds, then the stagnation is not due to over-penalization of complexity.
